queries.query: Bangaon West Bengal official cadastral map parcel land records GIS
queries.result: Found the official Government of West Bengal BanglarBhumi land-record portal, the Directorate of Land Records and Surveys as the state cadastral custodian, and the Basundhara state geoportal. Direct public parcel-service qualification did not succeed: BanglarBhumi and Basundhara timed out or exposed only general portal information during bounded inspection.

queries.query: বনগাঁ পশ্চিমবঙ্গ সরকারি জমির রেকর্ড মানচিত্র বাংলারভূমি
queries.result: Bengali-language discovery identified বনগাঁ as the local form of Bangaon and returned the official BanglarBhumi portal plus state cadastral/geoportal references; no anonymous Bangaon parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.

localCustodian.name: Directorate of Land Records and Surveys, Government of West Bengal / BanglarBhumi
localCustodian.evidence: The official BanglarBhumi portal identifies itself as the West Bengal Land and Land Reforms land-record service and lists plot/khatian, mouza-map availability, RS-LR information, and land-classification services. A Government of West Bengal cadastral-mapping notice identifies the Directorate of Land Records & Surveys as responsible for cadastral mapping and mouza maps. This evidences the state cadastral/land-record custodian, not a successfully qualified Bangaon parcel API.

generalAgency.name: West Bengal State Geoportal (Basundhara), Department of Science and Technology and Biotechnology
generalAgency.scope: General state geospatial discovery and WMS/WFS/WFS-T platform context; the public landing page says the portal is for government departments and does not by itself evidence a Bangaon parcel layer or anonymous download.

runtimeReadiness.reason: A real state land-record/cadastral custodian was evidenced, but no anonymous safe parcel ID+geometry response was qualified. Serial review must independently qualify any adapter before runtime use.
